How to play

Move around the arena to avoid the zombies. Your blaster automatically shoots the closest one.

  • ← ↑ ↓ → or WASD to move
  • Clear the shown zombie count to finish a round
  • Choose 1 of 3 upgrades between rounds

Build your survivor

Upgrade speed, reload time, or bullets per shot after each wave.

Every zombie defeated earns 2 Pixel Points. Your upgrades last for this run.
